For the Cellulose example, consult companion ownership review claim OWN-C09 and sources OWN-S05–OWN-S07; this review verifies the roster row, not those legal dates.

claims.finding: Standard Brands acquired all outstanding shares and certain debentures from BC Government for CAD 2.2 million on 1 December 1977.
Province held 40% at 31 March 1977; additional shares were acquired during 1977/78 before full holding was sold. Exact attainment of 100% not established.
claims.not_proven: Duration of wholly-owned phase; a claim of several months is unsupported by the checked evidence.
claims.confidence: high for endpoints; start day unknown
claims.graph_disposition: Eligible as historic wholly publicly owned entity; represent unknown/bounded ownership start. If renderer requires a precise continuous interval, hold interval rather than invent January 1 or March 31 start.

claims.finding: BC Cellulose bought 225 shares representing 2.5% under option exercised 23 June 1975; Province owned remaining 97.5%. This implies 100% combined direct and indirect public ownership.
claims.inference: 100% ultimate public ownership is arithmetic from two explicitly stated holdings and whole Crown ownership of BC Cellulose.
claims.graph_disposition: Add as publicly owned; retain two owners and exact percentages, do not label 100% directly Province-owned.
claims.date_semantics: 23 June is the minority-interest purchase. The two-owner snapshot is reported in statements at 31 December 1975.

claims.finding: 1977 comparator shows 8,775 shares/97.5% directly Province-owned; 1977/78 transfer combines these with 225 shares received as BC Cellulose dividend. All 9,000 shares transferred to BCRIC.
claims.graph_disposition: Record BCRIC transfer using approval/agreement date 9 March 1978; accounts independently confirm completed transfer by 31 March 1978. Do not turn order approval alone into proof of execution timing.

claims.finding: StatsCan 1973 reports 97% acquired by BC Cellulose effective 26 June 1973 and transferred directly to Province 24 October 1973.
claims.confidence: medium-high; official extracted text, page image not inspected here
claims.caution: Preserve 97% as printed; do not silently rewrite as 97.5% or assume all 1973 shares publicly owned.

claims.finding: Incorporated 15 March 1973 as British Columbia Cellulose Limited; statutory continuation as British Columbia Cellulose Company and Crown-agent status 18 April 1973.
claims.graph_disposition: Add distinct historic Crown node with two legal names, preserving incorporation and statutory continuation as separate events.

claims.finding: Scheduled agreement dated 2 April 1973 identifies British Columbia Cellulose Limited as wholly Crown-owned. It is distinct from Canadian Cellulose Company, Limited and Columbia Cellulose Company, Limited.
At 31 December 1975 the holding company owned 79% of Canadian Cellulose and 100% of Kootenay Forest Products, alongside its 2.5% of Plateau. Canadian Cellulose stake acquired 29 June 1973.
claims.caution: Do not merge BC Cellulose with Canadian/Columbia Cellulose or use a subsidiary 79% holding as Province ownership of the holding company.

claims.finding: Repeal statute assented 23 September 1983 but commencement required regulation; statute table gives repeal 31 March 1986. Accounts separately report dissolution effective 1 April 1986.
claims.confidence: high for each printed statement; unresolved legal day boundary
claims.graph_disposition: Use 1986 year-level endpoint and retain both dated source assertions. Do not assert 1983 dissolution. Retrieve original commencement regulation before selecting one exact legal dissolution day.
claims.conflict: Repeal Act s 2 ties dissolution to repeal, while accounts state following day. No evidence found establishing the exact legal reconciliation.
claims.roster_caution: Later StatsCan roster headed 31 December 1986 still lists this company; roster observation does not override law and accounts indicating 1986 termination.
